note: Read by test/tools/advertised-schema-parity.test.ts. Every entry must match a LIVE violation exactly:
- a violation with no entry FAILS the gate (new drift),
- an entry with no violation FAILS the gate (stale baseline - delete the row),
- a violation whose fingerprint CHANGED fails too, because the fingerprint names the exact keys.
That makes this file a ratchet: it can only be shortened by fixing things, and widening a known drift re-fails.
Add a row by hand, with a reason that says what is unreachable and why the repair is deferred. Never regenerate it wholesale.
Every row below was verified present at merge-base 5bd377f6 - none was introduced by the batch this file shipped with.
